title: To Whom It May Concern
author: ParadoxRogue
description:
You are writing a difficult letter in difficult times. The year is 1899 and something is terribly wrong.

The winds rattle the windowpanes of the attic in which you are forced to overwinter. It is not a terrible place to live, but these are difficult times for a traveler.

You have a letter to write, and an old typewriter on an ancient desk.

-

This is an interactive letter set in an alternate past. You can change the tone and details of the letter, but you cannot change the story.
